title: Gujarat Village's Haunted Well Resurfaces with Mysterious Water Ripples
summary: A well in Morbi, Gujarat, has started moving on its own again, sparking curiosity among locals. The incident has been reported by several outlets, each with their own framing of the story.
summary_points: The well is located in Morbi, Gujarat, and has a depth of 18 feet.
Locals have reported seeing ocean-like waves surging in the well water, despite no apparent seismic activity.
Several officials have ruled out seismic activity as the cause of the phenomenon.
The incident has sparked curiosity among villagers, with some drawing crowds to the site.
Experts have been called in to investigate the cause of the mysterious ripples.

center: Centrist outlets report on the incident as a mystery, with some highlighting the lack of apparent seismic activity.
Centrist outlets attribute the cause of the ripples to unknown factors, such as 'unusual geological conditions' or 'water table shifts'.
Centrist outlets emphasize the need for further investigation and scientific explanation.
right: Right-leaning outlets frame the incident as a potential security threat, with some speculating about possible terrorist activity.
Some right-leaning outlets attribute the cause of the ripples to foreign interference or sabotage.
Right-leaning outlets emphasize the need for increased security measures and vigilance.
